about: The tutorial's grading (M8 D79, TutorialRules). course: the instructor's own time round the buoy course in seconds; a time within exemplary_within of it (0.10: 10 %) rates exemplary, within par_within par, slower below par, and a destroyed buoy the worst. squadron_leader: the most Starfuries and civilians lost in the raid that still make the pilot squadron leader at once (with an exemplary course). raid: raiders through the jumpgate, then the number the strike carrier launches. Tuned after the play-test.
